strategy: Hermit Druid + Laboratory Maniac combo (BG core, U splash)
identity: BG(u) self-mill combo/value deck: ramp and tutors assemble Hermit Druid + Laboratory Maniac while a basic-depletion package strips the manabase's few basics from the library so a later Druid activation empties it; Crawl from the Cellar recurs Laboratory Maniac and any of several draw effects wins.
